messages:
ajay: heads up — saw a handful of customers with "ephemeral" stream credits that never got reconciled after a toolcall aborted mid-stream. ledger shows provisional tokens but no finalization.

noah: repro steps? any logs/trace ids we can use to correlate?

ajay: yes — example trace id 7f3a2: client starts stream -> router forwards -> toolcall 502 mid-chunk -> client reconnects. ledger provisional entry created at router:session:7f3a2 but no finalize event. pasted curl/trace: 
```
POST /v1/chat/stream
stream_start -> data: {session_id: "7f3a2", model: "redwood-large"}
... toolcall returns 502 at chunk 43
stream closed, client reconnects, new session_id 7f3a2-r1
```

sophia: console shows provisional>confirmed mismatch for a few orgs. looks like our provisional credits TTL expired without reconciliation. might be routing branch that never called finalize.

maria: is this specific to toolcalls or any mid-stream termination? curious if prefix-cache resume flow is involved.

ajay: seems tightly correlated with toolcall paths (router delegates to sidecar and awaits tool response). if sidecar fails after provisional charge but before ACK, we lose finalize.

sophia: quick mitigation: surface provisional credits per session in console so ops can spot spikes and we can undo obvious anomalies. longer term: add guaranteed finalize from router on session teardown (best-effort with retries + dead-letter).

noah: agree. also we should tag provisional entries with routing-path and attempt ids so reconciliation job can join events. right now ledger only has session_id and amount.

maria: data model change is small: add route_hint and attempt_id string (nullable). I can spike and run migration to backfill from traces. ETA EOD for spike.

ajay: can we do a safe short-term fix that doesn't require migration? e.g., make the router emit a finalize event to billing topic on shutdown, and console just groups by session_id for visibility.

devx: console work is straightforward — flag:show_provisional_sessions. I'll add a feature flag and a per-session provisional/confirmed column. won't affect billing yet.

ops-bot: incident template: Billing anomaly detected for org org-42 — provisional>confirmed on streams. If this becomes widespread, open an ops incident.

sophia: action items: 1) maria spike data model (ETA EOD) 2) devx quick console flag (PR today) 3) ajay to draft short RFC for router finalize + retries (tomorrow) 4) noah to add tracing tags to provisional events (low risk)

ajay: thanks — I'll start the RFC and link traces. tagging @maria @devx @noah. any objections to doing a rollout behind a flag?

maria: no objections. prefer behind flag.

noah: +1. also add a monitoring alert for provisional:confirmed ratio > 1.2 in a 30m window.

sophia: good call. I'll add a dashboard panel and alert.

ajay: cool — will update thread with RFC link and example queries. :thumbsup:
